name: Inventory and window synchronization
note: Removed with the first generation's server (tag pre-refactor) in the restructuring of 2026-11; returns with VIEW1. First generation: The server keeps each client's view of its window and sends the slots that differ after a tick, the whole window when the client describes another one or clicked on a stale state id; each window counts its own state ids. As both official servers do, an item use that changes the stack it takes from sends the whole own window (with a chest open, before the chest window's changes), one that leaves its stack as it was sends only what else changed, and a drop's change of the held slot is not sent
